::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1872? 1873?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. Microfiche copy The Women’s Library: 9/07/048 No.112 .
:::

My dear [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd)
I tried to get your questions answered by sending them to [Miss Bramston](people/person_198.qmd), the [Dean](people/person_197.qmd)’s daughter, but unluckily female education at Winchester received a blow when [Mr](people/person_85.qmd) & [Mrs Awdry](people/person_81.qmd) went to Hurstpierpoint - and [Mrs Johns](people/person_772.qmd), the only other lady who really cared, fell ill.  The getting lecturers down needs some energy and there is no one to do it now.

I send you Miss Bramston’s note and that from [Mrs Richards](people/person_1902.qmd), a lady who is trying to keep a school

yours truly
C M Yonge
